name: Vettora
summary: A fraud and ID-check desk for a marketplace, with a live order feed and a fraud-ring graph
about: A back-office app for the team that checks who people are and stops fraud on an online marketplace. Orders are scored live, risky ones land in a review queue to assign and resolve, ID documents are checked against selfies, and a link graph shows accounts tied together by shared phones, cards and addresses. It is for marketplace, payments and trust and safety teams.
how: Watch the live screening feed on the overview: a new order is scored every few seconds and risky ones open cases.
Open the review queue, filter by status or severity, assign a case from the Owner menu and open it to see why it was flagged.
Resolve a case as confirmed fraud or a false alarm; the account, order and totals update, and you can undo.
In ID checks, compare the document with the selfie, read the six checks and approve, reject with a reason or ask to resubmit.
On the link graph, watch the rings burst into place, drag points apart and block a whole ring with one button.
Drag the score band sliders on the Rules page, turn rules on or off, edit them and run a 30-day backtest.
Press Ctrl+K to jump to any page, case or account, and switch light or dark from the top bar.
